messages:
maria.g: Quick summary from the geo sweep I ran this morning for llama-2-13b quant-int8 — focused on p50/p95 impact from edge routing between us-east / us-west / eu-west. Short TL;DR below.

perf-bot: Command used: `bench_geo --model llama-2-13b --quant int8 --kernels auto --batch 1 --concurrency 8 --warmup 200 --samples 2000` across h100/a100, regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west.

perf-bot: Results (p50 / p95 median across runs):
- H100 (direct regional routing): us-east 34ms / 82ms, us-west 36ms / 85ms, eu-west 48ms / 140ms
- A100 (direct regional routing): us-east 42ms / 110ms, us-west 44ms / 118ms, eu-west 58ms / 165ms

maria.g: Key observation — p50 is tight across regions for H100 but p95 balloons in eu-west, especially on A100. Heap/kv-cache warmup looks fine; tail seems correlated with cross-pop proxy hops.

akshay: Did you run the routing toggle (edge fallback vs local-only) for the eu-west tests?

maria.g: Yes. With edge-routing disabled (force local regional serving) eu-west p95 drops ~30-40ms on H100 and ~45-60ms on A100. When routing allowed to prefer us-east for capacity, p95 jumps to 200ms+ in the worst runs.

lucy: That aligns with the proxy hop count hypothesis. Proxy trace showed 1 extra hop + 12–25ms jitter during peak. Logs: `proxy_trace: hops=3 rtt_ms=24..48 jitter=8..30`.

akshay: Kernel note — `kernels auto` picked fused attention kernel on H100 but fell back to generic on A100 for sequences >512. I re-ran a patch forcing improved kernel on A100 and saw p95 improve by ~10-15ms in eu-west (direct). Still worse when cross-region.

maria.g: Throughput/size note — With concurrency 8 we saturate model on A100 earlier; effective throughput per GPU on H100 ~1.35x A100 for this model/quant. Capacity sizing: for our 95th pct arrival pattern, recommend for eu-west: 1) provision an extra H100 standby for canary, or 2) pin routing local-only with elastic burst to other eu POPs (avoid us-east fallback).

op-bot: Deploy note: rolled routing flag `prefer-regional=true` to eu-west canary at 09:12 UTC (no user-facing change).

lucy: Action item — akshay to add a light-weight probe that forces `prefer-regional=false` vs `true` and records hop count + p95 for 30m window. maria to prepare short doc with suggested sizing numbers and cost delta.

akshay: I'll add the probe + small dashboard (p50/p95 per region, hop_count histogram, kernel used). Quick command I'm adding to the probe: `curl -sS http://edge-probe/run?model=llama-2-13b&quant=int8&force_local=%s&gpu=h100|a100` and record `kernel_name` from runtime header.

maria.g: Also flagging quality regression check — quant-int8 on A100 had slightly higher token drop (manual eval) in 8/200 samples vs H100. Not huge, but combine with latency tail it's worse UX. Add to eval set.

lucy: Cool. Can we also capture a tiny example set where fallback to us-east actually reduced correctness? We should include in the doc.

maria.g: Yep. I'll drop a mini-audit with 25 prompts and side-by-side outputs for local vs cross-region in the doc.

perf-bot: Summary action items:
- akshay: add probe + dashboard (due EOD)
- maria.g: sizing + mini-audit doc (due tomorrow)
- ops-bot: keep `prefer-regional` canary enabled and monitor error rates for 24h

ops-bot: Noted. Alerting: added a p95 > 180ms alert for eu-west for this model, channel #eng-oncall.

maria.g: Thanks — planning to publish short blurb in eng-ml channel after docs are in. For now, avoid cross-region fallbacks for latency-sensitive routes. :white_check_mark:
